A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same PDDLLM research work. All 31 pages of each version, including Appendices A.1-A.10, support comparison through text extraction and rendered-page inspection.

before.justification: v1 reports original simulation experiments, planning success rates, token and time costs, robustness analyses, and physical-robot demonstrations (Sections 6-8; Appendices A.1 and A.5-A.8).

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including the numerical comparisons and demonstrations using Franka Panda and Agilex Piper arms.

M1.justification: Predicate imagination, action invention, and the Logic-Constrained Action Sampler remain identical in Sections 5.1-5.2. The appendix prompt procedures and variants also match.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same nine task environments and two physical robot platforms. Task descriptions, compositional scenarios, and coverage in Sections 6 and 8 and Appendices A.1 and A.4 are unchanged.

E2.justification: Tables 2, 7, and 8 retain Expert, LLMTAMP, LLMTAMP-FF, LLMTAMP-FR, and RuleAsMem. Table 4 retains LLMTAMP, o1-TAMP, and R1-TAMP. Comparator membership is unchanged within each comparison.

E3.justification: Task sampling, model backbones, metrics, and evaluation procedures match. Both retain the 50-second main planning limit, 500-second reasoning-model comparison, and 25/100-second appendix evaluations (Sections 6-7; Appendix A.8).

E4.justification: The RuleAsMem ablation, complexity generalization, domain-quality analysis, prompt variations, and time-limit sensitivity tests examine the same questions with identical evidence (Section 7; Appendices A.5-A.8).

E5.justification: Section 6.1 reports three parallel runs and means with standard errors in both versions. Uncertainty reporting in the tables and plots is unchanged, with no added seed information or statistical procedures.

E6.justification: Numerical results and qualitative findings match throughout, including the appendices. For example, Table 2 retains overall success rates of 93.3±0.7% for PDDLLM, 52.5±0.4% for LLMTAMP-FF, and 93.4±0.1% for Expert under the same 50-second limit.

T1.justification: The PDDL formalization, assumptions, Equation (1), feature-space Definition 1, and planning-complexity reasoning are identical. No mathematical definition, derivation, theorem, or proof is added or removed.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain identical claims about domain derivation from demonstrations, automatic motion-planner integration, generalization, planning performance, and token efficiency.

C2.justification: Interpretations of domain quality and efficiency remain unchanged. Both retain the omitted-predicate limitation and bridge-building action-order example in Section 9, together with the applicability and safety qualifications in Appendix A.10.

D1.justification: The simulator/planner setup, baseline implementations, prompt templates, and robot integration details match. Appendix A.8 retains the same Intel Core i9-14900KF, no-GPU, and API-use disclosures; implementation and resource-access information are unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited-work set and related-work discussion remain unchanged. The revised Athalye et al. title/author information and explicit arXiv identifiers update metadata for retained references without changing research positioning.

P1.justification: Bibliography edits add explicit identifiers to ten existing arXiv references and revise capitalization and Athalye et al.'s title, adding Jiuguang Wang to that reference's authors. The marginal version/date stamp changes; main-text wording and appendix structure remain identical.

P2.justification: Bibliography edits produce limited changes to line wrapping and spacing on pages 10-12, and the first-page version stamp changes. All figures, tables, captions, and appendix pages render identically.

improvement.justification: v2 modestly improves bibliographic traceability by replacing generic arXiv subject tags with explicit identifiers for ten existing references and providing fuller Athalye et al. metadata (References, pages 10-12). The benefit is limited to reference clarity; the scientific content and all appendix evidence are unchanged.
